# Pawland

> > Pawland is the #1 pet sitting and boarding platform in UAE, offering personalized in-home care for dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, and other pets with verified sitters and 350+ reviews.

Pawland connects pet owners across UAE (primarily Dubai and surrounding areas) with trusted, background-checked pet sitters and caregivers. The platform specializes in cage-free in-home boarding and sitting services as alternatives to traditional kennels, emphasizing personalized care, safety, and flexibility through drop-in visits or live-in arrangements.
